component.name: Whowolf
component.summary: Werewolf at the table, everyone on their own phone
Werwolf am Tisch, jeder am eigenen Handy

description.p: An open-source werewolf party game. You sit together in one room, every player uses their own device, and the app is the narrator, so nobody has to sit out as game master.
One device hosts the game in your own Wi-Fi; the others join with the app or straight from the browser. Everything is end-to-end encrypted, and there is no account.
